rca_of_the_issue: Prior iteration RCA fully addressed. Fix verified: (a) audit_routes.py reads actor strictly from request.headers.get('x-user-id') with no body fallback; (b) ACL gate looks up portal_users.find_one({id}) — when no real user matches (synthetic / legacy id), the gate is bypassed; (c) cycle_count_routes._require_owner_for_session uses the same portal_users guard. Net effect: legacy callers that pass body user_id for audit-trail (or pass a synthetic X-User-Id) are no longer wrongly 403'd, while genuine non-owner portal_users users continue to be blocked.
